name: MiroFish
description: Swarm-intelligence prediction engine that simulates many agents reacting to seed material to forecast how events unfold.
whatItDoes: Takes documents such as news or reports plus a question, builds a simulated society of agents and reports the predicted outcome. Users can also interview individual simulated agents afterwards.
howItWorks: The backend extracts entities into a knowledge graph, creates agent personas with long-term memory in Zep, runs a parallel social simulation and has a report agent summarise it. A web front end drives the stages, and everything is configured through an env file.
